subject: numeric input widget does not enforce values

messages.author: 0906a16c411cc008
messages.subject: numeric input widget does not enforce values
parts: I've discovered that using a numeric input widget to obtain a numeric value from the user does not enforce values at the endpoints.  For example, the range can be specified as 1-10, but the user may still input 20, or 0, or -500.  Are there plans to expand the utility of the numeric input widget to restrict input values to those within the range?  I would like to see this widget act by taking my value of 20, setting it equal to the maximum, 10, and displaying a message informing me that this is what was done.  Thank you.
